description:
Turn on, change or stop a site's automatic Site Audit re-crawl, weekly or monthly at a fixed hour 05:00–10:00 UTC. Each run crawls up to max_pages like crawl_site, is compared with the crawl before (compare_crawls) and emails the owner the Site Health change and new and fixed issues. One schedule per site; calling again changes it and resumes a paused one.

Billing: free to schedule; when it runs, 1¢ per 10 pages fetched, billed as each run crawls; a run that hits a zero balance pauses the schedule.

When to call: after a crawl, to keep watching the site. Omit cadence (or dry_run: true) to read the schedule and quote; say max_cost_per_run_cents and monthly_estimate_cents to the user and turn it on only after they agree. Crawl settings passed are kept for every run.

Returns: { site_id, domain, schedule: { cadence, weekday, day_of_month, run_hour_utc, max_pages, notify, next_run_at, paused, paused_reason, last_run_at, last_skip_reason, settings? } | null, cost_per_run_cents (at the last crawl's size), max_cost_per_run_cents, monthly_estimate_cents, last_crawl_pages, rejected?, created?, resumed?, stopped?, dry_run?, note }. paused_reason out_of_credits: create_top_up_link, then call again with the cadence.

cadence.description: weekly, monthly, or off (deletes the schedule; past crawls stay). Omit to read the schedule and the quote.

cwv_urls.description: Up to 10 pages on the site to measure Core Web Vitals on, instead of the automatic sample.

day_of_month.description: Monthly: the day it runs, 1–28. Default: the current one, else 1.

device.description: desktop (default) or mobile user agent (both AuditAE-Bot).

domain.description: The site's domain as added to AuditAE, e.g. "acme.com". Or pass site_id.

dry_run.description: true: return the quote and the schedule it would make; change nothing.

exclude.description: Skip URLs matching these masks (include's syntax; exclude wins). Counted in skipped_by_rules.

exclude_checks.description: Check ids (checks[].id) to leave out of Site Health and the theme scores; they report not_run 'excluded'.

ignore_params.description: Query parameters to drop from URLs (e.g. ["sort", "page_*"]); ["*"] drops every query string.

include.description: Only crawl URLs whose path+query matches one of these masks (robots.txt syntax: * wildcard, $ end, else prefix; /shoes/ is the folder). The homepage is always fetched.

max_pages.description: Most pages per run, 1–10000; 1¢ per 10 pages. Default: the current one, else 1.2 × the last whole-site crawl or the URL list's size, else 10000.

notify.description: Email the owner a summary after each run. Default true.

robots_agent.description: Obey this bot's robots.txt group instead of User-agent: * (e.g. OAI-SearchBot, as ChatGPT search may crawl). Still identifies as AuditAE-Bot.

site_id.description: AuditAE site id from list_sites. Or pass domain.

sitemap_url.description: source=sitemap_url: the sitemap file or index to crawl; must be on the site.

source.description: What to crawl: site (default: links + sitemap), sitemaps (only the sitemaps' URLs), sitemap_url (one sitemap file), urls (only the listed URLs, plus the homepage). Default: the site's saved crawl settings, else site. On a schedule, each settings field passed changes only that field (pass an empty value such as exclude: [] to clear one); the saved URL list stays unless urls or another source is passed.

speed.description: normal (default, 3 at a time), polite (1 page a second; 10,000 pages ≈ 3 h) or robots (robots.txt Crawl-delay, max 10 s).

subdomains.description: Also crawl subdomains of the site's domain (each obeys its own robots.txt; up to 25 hosts). Default false.

urls.description: source=urls: up to 2,000 URLs on the site (off-site ones are rejected and returned in rejected). max_pages is clamped to the list.

weekday.description: Weekly: the day it runs. Default: the current one, else monday.

name: schedule_crawl
title: Re-crawl a site weekly or monthly, with a summary email
